input.overview: Amazon Hunt links the A-B-C lanes to Bonus X, Extra Ball, and both side Specials. Complete A-B-C to advance Bonus X and light the top-center rollover for Extra Ball. Complete A-B-C plus the left drop bank to light the left hole for Special, or pair A-B-C with the right bank to light the right hole. Lit spot targets, drops, and rollovers add bonus. After both five-target banks are down, only the two black center targets return; each is then worth 50,000. The final ball starts with 2x Bonus and an A-B-C completion raises it to 3x.
input.simpleOverview: Complete A-B-C to advance Bonus X and light Extra Ball at the top-center rollover. Complete A-B-C plus either five-target drop bank, then shoot the matching side hole for Special. On the final ball, A-B-C raises the starting 2x Bonus to 3x.
input.summary: Take A-B-C whenever the lanes are controllable, then choose the safer side bank and matching hole instead of splitting progress across both. On the final ball, prioritize A-B-C early so the larger multiplier applies to every later bonus advance.

quickInfo.name: Extra Ball
quickInfo.summary: Complete A-B-C, then roll through the lit top-center lane.

quickInfo.name: Left Special
quickInfo.summary: Complete A-B-C and the left bank, then shoot the left hole.

quickInfo.name: Right Special
quickInfo.summary: Complete A-B-C and the right bank, then shoot the right hole.

steps.text: Complete A-B-C through the top and lower lanes to advance Bonus X and light the top-center rollover for Extra Ball.
Roll through the lit top-center lane to collect Extra Ball when available.
Complete whichever five-target drop bank is safer; with A-B-C complete, that bank lights its matching side hole for Special.
Shoot the lit left or right hole to collect Special.

alternatives.title: Black-target scoring
alternatives.when: Use this after both five-target banks have been cleared and the center black targets are returning cleanly.

steps.text: Clear both drop-target banks so only the two black center targets reset.
Hit the returning black targets for 50,000 each while keeping the rebound away from the center drain.
Begin the final ball with the game's automatic 2x Bonus.
Complete A-B-C before building more bonus to raise the multiplier to 3x.

machineSetup: Test all A-B-C lanes, both five-target banks, the two black center targets, both side holes, the top-center Extra Ball rollover, and the alternating add-bonus spot targets.
Verify the installed CPU or replacement board preserves final-ball 2x, A-B-C to 3x, and Extra Ball behavior; hybrid and aftermarket boards can handle last-ball carryover differently.

playfieldReferences.description: Top lane that collects Extra Ball after A-B-C.

playfieldReferences.label: Black center drop targets
playfieldReferences.description: Targets that return for 50,000 after both banks are cleared.

cautions.issue: The two drop banks can return the ball toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Work one angled bank from a controlled flipper and stop forcing the black-target loop when rebounds become straight down the middle.
